_doc: Shared cases for the human title of a background-process completion row. Pinned by BOTH twins: tools/process_registry_notifications.py (process_job_label / process_completion_display_text / relabel_legacy_process_title, tests/tools/test_process_completion_title.py) and apps/desktop/src/lib/process-title.ts (vitest). A title never carries the shell command, a path or a job id.
